cleanup.scope: Obsolete project object-cache entries; current unit/structural/profile caches and final compiler hashes excluded; no open project-cache files observed

input_deduplication.method: Byte-compare each completed replay input with the original capture; atomically replace the duplicate path with a hard link; preserve original capture inode and every content hash

subsequent_cleanup.delta_scope: Concurrent validation can allocate or release data; observed free delta is not an exact attributed reclamation total

interruption.cause: Cleanup removed a cached compiler that a subsequent behavioral zig build run expected, despite no open cache files at the audit instant
interruption.recovery: Retain the interrupted run and reset stale project cache manifests. A rebuild generated a different binary identity, retained in cache-rebuild-binary.sha256; restore the previously validated compiler to the identical build-cache key and reinstall it. Verify the original accepted/default compiler hashes, then rerun the complete cumulative gate without further cache cleanup

runtime_setup_interruption.recovery: Final runtime-replay-final run admitted after cleanup; all 455 definitions completed and event stream audited

excluded_attempts: interrupted-acceptance stopped during behavioral checks after cache removal; full gate rerun after cache recovery
rerun-setup refused the retained prior scratch directory before any gate; final run uses a fresh serial scratch root
runtime-replay-accepted stopped at admission; runtime-replay-final supplies the accepted complete replay
